name: University of Kansas
description: The University of Kansas is a top-tier public research university located in Lawrence, Kansas and has a commitment to a research-focused academic curriculum and career support. In its 2021 report, U.S. News & World Report ranked KU as tied for 124th place among National Universities and tied for 60th place among public universities. Timestamps
